name: Jake Cooper
current_role: CEO and Co-Founder, Grow Therapy (New York)
profile: Jake Cooper co-founded Grow Therapy in 2020 with Duke friends Manoj Kanagaraj and Alan Ni after a private-equity career at Apollo and Blackstone. Grow helps therapists run insurance-covered practices; it has a network of ~26,000 providers, has raised $328M+ and is valued around $3B.
interesting_fact: Grow says 220 million Americans can access its therapists through their health plan, and 60% of Grow providers opt in to Medicaid and Medicare.
deep_cut_fact: As a Duke undergrad (B.S. Economics, summa cum laude, Phi Beta Kappa) he was CFO of Campus Enterprises LLC, Duke's student-run business group, in 2014-15, before joining Apollo in 2016.
notes: Deep-cut source is a profile aggregator; confirm Campus Enterprises role if used. Best route is Grow's comms head per the official media kit.

name: Sheetal Lalwani
profile: Sheetal Lalwani co-founded Juspay in 2012 with Vimal Kumar (and Ramanathan RV, who left in 2019). Juspay is a payments-infrastructure firm processing 400M+ transactions a day for 500+ enterprises; it raised a $50M Series D in Jan 2026 at a $1.2B valuation and is profitable. She has said Juspay aims for $1B revenue before an IPO.
interesting_fact: Juspay was founded to make India's 2011 two-factor-authentication mandate seamless, and spent four years building UPI infrastructure with no monetisation; it now powers a significant part of UPI.
notes: Low personal profile; speaks for the company on open source/AI ('Linux for payments') and global expansion. Interviewed by The Fintech Times 'Behind the Idea'.
